records.locator: Section II.1, printed p. 129 (PDF p. 171); original publication provenance on p. 127
records.note: The source reports 696 all-cause chamber reactions against 15,370 person-exposures and cites 4.5%. The 1,578 chamber sessions are a separate count. No DCS-specific tally, reaction timing, role strata, or unique participant count is supplied.

observations.locator: Section II.1, printed p. 129 (PDF p. 171); original publication provenance on p. 127
observations.protocol: Taiwan Air Force hypobaric chamber training during 1959–1986. The chapter discusses four training profiles but supplies only a pooled outcome. Pressure history, prebreathe and activity by exposure are unavailable.
observations.outcome_window: Reactions recorded in connection with chamber flights. A fixed follow-up window is unavailable.
observations.note: The source reports 696 all-cause chamber reactions against 15,370 person-exposures and cites 4.5%. The 1,578 chamber sessions are a separate count. No DCS-specific tally, reaction timing, role strata, or unique participant count is supplied. The author labels the numerator 人 and the denominator 人次. Deduplication within affected people cannot be checked.
